# 1784. Check if Binary String Has at Most One Segment of Ones

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def checkOnesSegment(self, s):
        """
        :type s: str
        :rtype: bool
        """
        flag = False
        for c in s:
            if not flag and c == "0":
                flag = True
            elif flag and c == "1":
                return False
        return True
```
